data.body: Landed as Gerrit 3274, merged 2026-11-03 15:09 PST as 0e7401446c5 (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved, submitted at 54fbd49c5b1). Patch set 1 was Verified -1 only on the 800-LOC module cap (formatting pushed _ref_lock.py to 803); patch set 2 shortened the constant to _OBJ_READ_SECS (file now 799 lines) and added the set_pause test LLM-Review suggested. Evidence: tests/unit/reconciler/state/test_ref_lock_blob_read_budget.py has 5 tests; with _OBJ_READ_SECS set back to the local budget 4 fail, with the fix all 5 pass. The blobless-clone test asserts the payload blob is absent (git cat-file -e under GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1 fails) before read() returns the released state. make lint 0, make typecheck 0, pytest tests/unit/reconciler/ 3689 passed (patch set 1 code), tests/unit/reconciler/state + raw-git lint 610 passed (patch set 2). ADR 0121 section 10 amended; docs/adr/0031 unchanged. Remaining: the first scheduled reconcile-bridge run after the merge (~15:24 PST) and the alarm returning to OK.
